description: Unique identifier for each synthetic residential property listing
Indian State or Union Territory name
Two-letter official ISO state code
Administrative district name
Standardized district abbreviation code
Sub-district administrative entity (Mandal, Taluk, Tehsil, or Block)
Locality, neighborhood, ward, or village name
Geographic latitude of property location (WGS84)
Geographic longitude of property location (WGS84)
6-digit Indian Postal PIN Code
Category of residential property (Apartment, Independent House, Villa, Builder Floor, Residential Plot)
Type of market listing (Sale, Resale, New Booking)
Possession timeline status (Ready to Move, Under Construction)
Legal ownership transaction type (Freehold, Leasehold, Power of Attorney)
Total plot or land parcel area in square feet
Total enclosed built-up area including walls and balconies
Net usable internal floor area (carpet area <= built_up_area)
Number of bedrooms (BHK room count)
Number of bathrooms/toilets
Number of attached balconies or verandas
Floor on which property is situated (0 for ground)
Total number of floors in the structure
Age of the building in years (0 indicates brand new or under construction)
Interior furnishing state (Unfurnished, Semi-Furnished, Fully Furnished)
Designated vehicle parking slots (car/two-wheeler)
Main entrance facing direction (Vastu orientation)
Width of access road fronting the property
Binary flag indicating whether property is located within a secured gated community (1=Yes, 0=No)
Specification grade of construction (Economy, Standard, Premium, Luxury)
Physical maintenance condition (New, Excellent, Good, Needs Renovation)
Distance to the primary municipal/central business district
Distance to the nearest major arterial road
Distance to the nearest national/state expressway or highway
Distance to nearest rapid metro transit station (99.0 if no metro exists)
Distance to the nearest mainline railway terminal
Distance to the nearest operational civil airport
Distance to the nearest reputable school or academy
Distance to the nearest multi-specialty hospital or clinic
Distance to the nearest shopping mall or commercial market
Distance to major IT/business park or industrial cluster
Public transport connectivity accessibility rating (High, Moderate, Low)
Zoning character of immediate surrounding area (Residential, Commercial-Residential Mixed, Gated Township, Suburban Layout, Rural Settlement)
Urbanization classification (Urban, Semi-Urban, Rural)
Total synthetic property price in Indian Rupees (Primary Target)
Derived unit price per square foot of built-up area (price_inr / built_up_area_sqft)
Prevailing land valuation per square foot in locality
Independent synthetic algorithmic property appraisal / benchmark value
